about_the_game:
Man the helm and dominate the seas!

Prepare for intense naval combat as you command your ship through relentless battles. Outsmart your enemies, upgrade your firepower, and survive the treacherous waters—because only the strongest will rule the ocean.

Included in the Demo:

  • Ship vs ship combat – Engage in thrilling battles against enemy vessels and test your tactical skills.

  • Play up to Level 4 – Unlock and experience new ships and enemy encounters as you advance.

  • Upgrades & Customization – After each match, spend your earned points on a limited selection of upgrades to improve your ship’s strength against tougher foes.

  • Collectibles – Pick up floating barrels to gain experience, restore health, or activate temporary boosts for weapons and speed.

  • Dynamic Naval Hazards – Navigate through environmental challenges, including dense vegetation that obscures underwater threats, deadly islands that can sink you instantly, and an increasing number of enemies as you progress.

  • Four Unique Enemy Vessels – Face different enemy ships, each varying in size, durability, weapon count, and weapon type.

Are you ready to set sail, Captain?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th Gen or higher) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Take your warship into the open seas and defeat the enemy that seek to destroy you. Experience ship variants ranging from torpedo boats to warships.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
